newsitem.title: NORWAY: Aker Maritime forecasts moderate growth.
newsitem.headline: Aker Maritime forecasts moderate growth.

text.p: Norwegian offshore services company Aker Maritime ASA said on Wednesday it exected moderate growth in sales and profits in 1997.

The company, formed last November after Aker ASA spun off its Oil and Gas Technology division and merged it with offshore supplier Maritime Group, posted full-year 1996 operating profits at 230 million crowns. The proforma 1995 comparitive figure was 188 million crowns.
In a statement announcing its 1996 results, Aker Maritime said its 1997 results would be influenced by the Njord oil project on the Norwegian continental shelf.
"The financial development in the Njord project for (operator) Norsk Hydro is not satisfying. This is especially negative for Aker Engineering and Aker Stord," the company said.
In December Aker Stord claimed 518 million crowns from Norsk Hydro for extra work on the Njord floating production system. Aker said the negotiations over the claim were still to be settled.
